shots.setup: G.filmCam = null; if (window.__d && G.ember.champions().endDuel) { G.ember.champions().endDuel(); window.__d = null; } G.champ = null; for (const k in (G.bosses||{})) { const b = G.bosses[k]; if (b.active && b.stop) b.stop(); } G.enemies.clearAll && G.enemies.clearAll(); for (const q of (G.enemies.encounters || [])) q.cleared = true; { const SP = G.combat.powers && G.combat.powers.spout; if (SP && SP.clear) SP.clear(); } { const h0 = G.hero; h0.carried = null; if (h0.endFly) h0.endFly(); h0.fly = false; h0.glide = false; h0.fireAir = false; } if (window.__keep) { G.combat.data.champions.phases.forEach((p, i) => (p.moves = window.__keep[i])); window.__keep = null; } window.__want = null; window.__to = null; window.__orb = null; window.__e = null; window.__B = null; window.__b = null; window.__wn = 0; window.__burnt = false; G.ember.setSide('water', { place: false, quiet: true }); Q.start(); G.bot = null; G.quest.botDrive = null; G.quest.debugRingAll(); const h = G.hero, V = h.pos.constructor; h.hp = h.maxHp = 900; h.tide = h.maxTide = 100; for (const k in h.powers) h.powers[k] = true; h.inv = 1e6; window.__n = 0; h.powers.ice = true; if (G.combat.unlockStance) G.combat.unlockStance('ice'); if (G.sky.setHour) G.sky.setHour(0.42); Q.swimAt(-60, -620, -0.4); G.camYaw = 1.2; G.camPitch = 0; h.heading = G.camYaw; window.__want = 'water'; { const fx = Math.sin(G.camYaw), fz = Math.cos(G.camYaw), rx = -fz, rz = fx; for (const [a, b] of [[6, -2.2], [7.5, 1.8], [9, -0.4], [6.5, 3.2]]) G.enemies.spawn('reaver', new V(h.pos.x + fx * a + rx * b, -0.6, h.pos.z + fz * a + rz * b)); } __rig.hero({ dist: 5.6, up: 2.2, ang: 0.35, look: [3, 0.3], fov: 60, k: 6, under: false }); 'ok'
shots.each: window.__n++; const n = window.__n, h = G.hero; h.inv = 1e6; h.hp = h.maxHp; h.tide = h.maxTide; h.boostFuel = 1; for (const e of G.enemies.alive()) if (e.hp < 60) e.hp = 250; const P = {"10": "wave", "70": "atk", "80": "atk", "110": "wave"}; const w = { mx: 0, my: 0, ud: 0 }; if (n === 1 && window.__want && h.stance !== window.__want) w.stance = true; w.ud = h.pos.y < -0.5 ? 0.8 : 0; if (P[n]) w[P[n]] = true; Q.drive(w);
shots.log: (() => { const c = G.camera, h = G.hero, p = (h.drawPos || h.pos).clone(); p.y += 0.9; const d = +p.distanceTo(c.position).toFixed(1); p.project(c); return [+p.x.toFixed(2), +p.y.toFixed(2), d, +h.pos.x.toFixed(0), +h.pos.y.toFixed(1), +h.pos.z.toFixed(0)]; })()
